reason: Both proposals are nearly identical, but Candidate A includes an unsupported claim that the fluorine treatment will 'induce the formation of a continuous and adherent Al2O3 protective layer' on HfNbTaTiZr, despite the cited evidence only demonstrating this effect on Ti-Al-Nb alloys, which contain aluminum. HfNbTaTiZr lacks aluminum, so the mechanism is physically unsound for this material, making Candidate A less grounded. Candidate B avoids this overstatement by not specifying Al2O3 formation, making it more cautious and testable.
